description: Request onboarding to FLOCORE governance for your world-affecting actions (human-gated approval, Ed25519 signed receipts, EU AI Act Article 12 audit evidence). Public: no token needed. This registers a request for HUMAN review and issues NO token; you get a request id and are contacted once approved.

intended_use.description: optional: what world-affecting actions you want governed

org.description: optional: the organisation the agent acts for

owner_contact.description: an email or handle we can reach to confirm onboarding

referred_by.description: optional: the governed agent or partner that sent you here (so credit flows to whoever brought you)

name: flocore_onboard_request
